_note: Animal classes (every animal has one, in animals.json "class") and the Specialists' traits ("trait"). Where each class stands in an army: "formation"; how many animals a card brings: "squads". counters: extra damage (percent) one class does to another; less for a negative number (Tanks are armored: everyone but Tank Destroyers does 30% less to them). A class's targets and range override the animal's own (Ranged reach at least `range` tiles; Air flies). line: the one short line shown when you hold a card.

classes.name: Air
classes.line: Flies. Only Ranged and Air can hit it.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.line: Digs under and pops up behind the enemy.

traits.name: Stun
traits.line: Every second hit freezes the target.

prefer._note: Who goes after what first, if it's within this many tiles: Tank Destroyers look for Tanks, Ranged for Air.

squads._note: What one card's animals carry into a fight between them, by class: as much as `units` animals each with hp_pct and damage_pct of the card's health and bite (so a squad of 3 at 36% is a little more than one animal at 100%). How many animals a card really brings is its group (groups, below), which shares this equally. radius: how much room each takes (tiles) when it has no body of its own in bodies.json. spacing: how far apart neighbours stand in a line (tiles, centre to centre). line_max: how many fit in one line before a second line forms behind. leash: how far (tiles) an animal may leave its place in the formation to fight. Specialists stand at the outer ends of the rank their trait belongs to. A Mythic's animals are heroes (a gold ring, the middle of their rank's first line) with the room in `mythic`; how big each animal is drawn is bodies.json.

groups._note: Every card brings a group of its animal, sized by the animal's build: small animals come as a bunch, big ones as a few (by_build: how many; builds: each animal's build, one not listed is `default`). The group shares what its class's squad carries (squads, above) equally between its animals: a Tank's 150% of the card's health is 2 Elephants at 75% each, or 4 Snapping Turtles at 37.5% each, so a card is worth the same whatever its group. tune: a card's whole group this many percent of that (100 if not listed), for the cards a bigger or smaller group changed the worth of (tests/power_report.tscn finds them: a trick that every animal of a bunch does is worth more than one animal doing it).

formation._note: How an army lines up (tiles): one block across the field. Ranks from the front: the Tank wall, the Tank Destroyer line, then the Ranged ranks; Air hovers over the Tank Destroyer line (`over`: a rank drawn over another, `over_offset` tiles behind it, taking no room of its own). Each rank's lines hold at most its class's line_max (squads, above) and as many as fit across the field, keeping edge_margin tiles from its sides. A card's group stands together: the first in the middle of the line, the next ones to its right and left in turn. Specialists stand with the rank their trait belongs to (rank_of_row: Burrowers with the wall, the rest with the Tank Destroyers, where they can reach a fight), after its own groups, so at its outer ends. rank_gap: extra room between ranks; line_gap: between two lines of the same rank. Every other line of a `stagger` rank is shifted half a place so all can shoot. An animal whose reach (its card's range, or its attack style's) is at least back_reach tiles stands in a line of its own at the very back of its rank, so its range shows (the King Cobra).
